name: opt-console-ops-tables
prompt: Turn this into a different screen of the same web app: the Smart-Clearance super-admin console, shown edge to edge with no browser window. Keep the reference's visual system exactly: pale sage-white background, the frosted left sidebar, white cards and tables with thin hairline edges and soft shadows, the deep green brand colour, the heavy grotesque page title and the clean sans interface text. Replace every piece of the reference's content, including everything in the lower half of the page. Layout: 1) Left sidebar: the green rounded-square S logo with "Smart-Clearance" and a small grey "Console" under it; navigation items "Overview", "Clients" (selected, white pill), "Agents", "Connectors", "Plans", "Staff", "Audit log"; at the bottom a small round portrait with "Neha Kulkarni" and "Super admin". 2) Top of the main area: the large title "Clients", a search field "Search clients, domains, people" and a dark green button "New client". 3) A white card holding a dense table with sortable column headers "Client", "Workspace", "Plan", "Status", "Batches", "Recovered", "Agents". One row: an orange rounded tile with a white letter m and "Munchly Foods", "munchly.smartclearance.com" in monospace, "Pilot", a small green "Live" pill, "2", "₹47,152", "10 of 10 on". 4) Under it, filling the rest of the page, a second wide white card titled "Agent runs today" with a dense table: columns "Agent", "Client", "Last run", "Next run", "Result"; rows "Watcher · Munchly Foods · 09:00 · tomorrow 09:00 · 2 batches at risk", "Vision · Munchly Foods · 09:14 · on request · label read, 0.97", "Valuer · Munchly Foods · 09:21 · on request · 5 exits priced", "Router · Munchly Foods · 09:22 · on request · plan sent for approval", "Negotiator · Munchly Foods · 10:05 · on bid · countered ₹14.20". Small green and amber status dots in the Result column. 5) A command palette floating over the upper middle of the screen: a white rounded panel with a search input reading "Configure Watcher for Munchly" and three result rows "Munchly Foods → Agents → Watcher", "Invite a person to Munchly", "Pause every agent for Munchly", with "⌘K" at the right of the input. Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Option: Operations tables, clients and agent runs in dense tables with a command palette.
